World annual series, 1946–2025, split by four state-based conflict types
transformation: The local extract keeps the OWID world rows for best, low, and high estimates. No country allocation, interpolation, or indirect-death estimate is added. The local extract sums the four mutually exclusive world conflict-type columns—interstate, internationalized intrastate, non-internationalized intrastate, and extrasystemic—into one annual total. No regional totals are summed.
